name: alignment
description: Sequence-to-sequence alignment: pairwise (Bio.Align, parasail, edlib, WFA), multiple sequence alignment (MAFFT, MUSCLE5, ClustalOmega, T-Coffee, BAli-Phy joint co-estimation), structural alignment (Foldseek, Foldseek-Multimer, TM-align, US-align, DALI, Foldmason), alignment I/O, post-MSA filtering / trimming / column-mapping (ClipKIT, trimAl, BMGE, PhyIN), and alignment analysis (conservation, identity, coevolution) (7 skills)
